content.introduction: According to Bloomberg, the Health Care sector has a weight of 10% and a % change of 2.50% as of November 5, 2026. The Health Care Equipment & Services sub-sector has a weight of 32% and a % change of 4.32%, while the Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences sub-sector has a weight of 68% and a % change of 2.43%. The Financials sector, in comparison, has a weight of 12% and a % change of 2.74%. The overall All Sectors index has a % change of 4.30%. The specific phone numbers and URLs for Bloomberg support are not provided in the sources.
